latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor B-Roll

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for automatic b-roll enhancement.
- AI detects and inserts relevant b-roll clips to cover cuts and pauses, returning a ready-to-post 1080p MP4.
- Easy setup with automatic token handling; connects to a cloud backend for processing (no software install needed).
- Supports credits, export status, track previews, and session management via intuitive commands.
- Detailed error handling and seamless user feedback for token, file, export, and credit issues.
